ship.name: Raven Navy Issue
ship.purpose: Visual truth set for a credible non-neural rendering baseline and UV-repair proof.

unlockRequirements: Every rendered draw range has a known shader family.
Every critical semantic input resolves through either separate or packed texture bindings.
Four material-slot parameters resolve for the active V5 hull shader.
Material separation, normal response, roughness, glow and markings resemble the in-game references.
The known stretched UV damage remains visible in baseline mode.
No draw range uses the tint-only fallback.

expected: Dark and light hull materials remain clearly separated.
Broad panel and camouflage variation remains visible.
Cyan navy accents, small lights and surface markings survive.
The hull does not collapse into a uniform blue-grey material.
Bright metal remains controlled rather than clipped.
Normal-map relief remains crisp on the launcher and support structures.
Dark hull regions retain readable detail.
Large striped panel identity remains intact.
Panel edges and rivet-like details remain visible.
The source UV stretching remains visible before repair.
RVN-7R text and circular insignia are preserved where source resolution permits.
Repair methods must not invent or alter markings.
Directional smearing and enlarged texels remain measurable in baseline mode.
A repair is accepted only when this region improves while clean controls remain unchanged.
